plugin.name: themed-minimize
plugin._long: Adds the effects "genie" and "scale" for minimising and restoring windows to the animate plugin. Choose one with animate's minimize_animation option.

option.name: genie_duration
option._long: How long the genie effect takes. The curve should be linear: the effect does its own easing.

option.name: scale_duration
option._long: How long the scale effect takes. The curve should be linear: the effect does its own easing.
